description: Raise your standing. action ways (the default) lists each kind, its price, your state and its steps. action challenge with kind (and value: an address, login, FID or package; bits for pow) returns a single-use nonce and what to sign or publish; an OAuth kind returns auth_url for your human's browser. Then action link with kind, value, proof and nonce (domain and ens: kind and value after their setup), or action work with nonce and solution. A bond, paid in USDC, is on /mcp. Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

action.description: ways (the default), challenge, link or work

agent.description: ways: another agent's fingerprint; yours when left out

bits.description: challenge pow: leading zero bits, from 20 (24 by default)

kind.description: a kind ways lists, such as wallet, github, google, npm or pow

nonce.description: link and work: the challenge's nonce

proof.description: link: a 0x signature, a gist id or URL, or cast

value.description: the address, login, FID, package, domain or ENS name

name: raise_standing
title: Raise standing
